payload.name: Resource Floors Pause the Work, They Never Skip or Refuse It
payload.description: When the host runs low on memory or a write queue fills, work waits and resumes. It is not skipped, stopped, failed or refused.

principles.name: A guard waits
principles.description: A resource guard protects the host by pausing; it is never a reason to drop work.

heuristics.condition: a numeric floor sits in a loop
heuristics.action: name it as a host guard with its environment variable and default, and list it in the registry
record that it has no wait point as an open gap

decision_rules.name: Wait, do not refuse
decision_rules.condition: host memory is below the floor
decision_rules.outcome: pause and resume at the defined wait points: the start of a walk, before each step, before each re-expansion candidate and loop gap, and in the link worker; never skip, stop or fail the work

decision_rules.name: An unreadable measure is no reason to wait
decision_rules.condition: the memory figure cannot be read
decision_rules.outcome: there is nothing to wait for; continue

decision_rules.name: Backpressure blocks writers
decision_rules.outcome: block the producers until space frees; drop nothing; the bound is host memory

decision_rules.name: Give every actor a wait point
decision_rules.condition: a loop or actor is added
decision_rules.outcome: give it the same wait point, or record in the registry why it cannot
